fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as on Aadhaar. Working Women Hostel provides safe and affordable accommodation for working women with income up to Rs 50,000/month in cities, Rs 35,000 in smaller towns.
fields.instruction_hi: Aadhaar ke anusar poora naam likhein. Working Women Hostel shaharon mein 50,000/maah aur chote sheharon mein 35,000/maah tak aay wali kaamkaaji mahilaon ko surakshit aur sasti rehaaish deta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your age. The hostel also accommodates children up to age 5 if the mother needs to bring them. Working women of any age are eligible.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni aayu likhein. Hostel mein 5 saal tak ke bachche bhi reh sakte hain agar maata ko unhe saath laana ho. Kisi bhi aayu ki kaamkaaji mahilaayen paatra hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the name of your employer or organization. A certificate of employment is required to prove you are a working woman and eligible for the hostel.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne niyokta ya sanstha ka naam likhein. Employment certificate chahiye jo sabit kare ki aap kaamkaaji mahila hain aur hostel ke liye paatra hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your monthly income. Must be within prescribed limits: Rs 50,000/month for metro cities, Rs 35,000/month for other areas to be eligible.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni maasik aay likhein. Nirdhaarit seemaon ke andar honi chahiye: metro shaharon ke liye 50,000 rupaye/maah, anya kshetron ke liye 35,000 rupaye/maah paatrata ke liye.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the city where you need hostel accommodation. Applications are made to the specific hostel in the city where you work.
fields.instruction_hi: Woh shehar likhein jahan aapko hostel rehaaish chahiye. Aavedan usi hostel mein kiya jaata hai jahan aap kaam karte hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar for identity verification and hostel registration.
fields.instruction_hi: Pahchaan verification aur hostel registration ke liye 12 ank ka Aadhaar likhein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your mobile number for application status updates and hostel communication.
fields.instruction_hi: Application status updates aur hostel communication ke liye mobile number likhein.
